issues.detail: The requirement specifies delivery for registered addresses but does not define a user-facing response for an unregistered address.
The expected result deferred the outcome to product clarification instead of defining an observable boundary-consistency check.
The expected result deferred the multiple-link outcome to clarification without stating the observable outcomes to record.
Email case normalization and whitespace trimming are not specified by the requirement and are not required to verify a documented rule.
